test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question: Who among the following Indian boxers secured second place in men’s 69 kg weight category at the Asian Boxing Olympic Qualifiers held in Amman, Jordon?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Vikas Krishan.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vikas Krishan** upstaged Kazakhstan's Ablaikhan Zhussupov to get to the final of the welterweight class at the **Asian boxing Olympic qualifiers in Amman, Jordan.**
 
• This was as well **India's first win** after heavyweights **Amit Panghal and Lovlina Borgohain **bowed out earlier in the day.
 
• Indian boxer** Vikas Krishan,** who take part in the** 69kg weight division at Tokyo 2020**, will be moving up to the** 80kg class for the Paris 2024 Olympics.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amit Panghal** is an Indian Army Junior Commissioned Officer and an amateur boxer.​ 
 
• **Ashish Kumar** is an Indian amateur boxer who competes within the middleweight category. 
 
• **Manish Kaushik** is an Indian boxer who completes in the lightweight division.
